_readme: PROVISIONING settings for DEV — rev_setting rows ONLY (D-020 fix, 2026-08-14).
This is DELIBERATELY NOT dev-settings.json: several scripts and their tests
(verify-role-bindings.ps1, ensure-bulk-delete-jobs.ps1, ProvisioningCommon.Tests.ps1,
DataverseScripts.Tests.ps1) rely on `Get-ProvisioningSettings -Env dev` throwing
'file not found' as the signal that DEV has no group-team bindings, auditing config
or bulk-delete jobs scripted against it in Phase 1 — that invariant must not break.
provisioning/dataverse/seed-settings.ps1 reads THIS file directly for -Env dev,
exactly the way ensure-schema.ps1 reads dev-schema-settings.json instead of
dev-settings.json. See both scripts' own header comments.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AT ALL: seed-settings.ps1 was wired into
config/revitalise-grant-automation-pipeline.yml for `test` and `prd` only. DEV's
first live deployment (2026-08-14) therefore left rev_setting with 0 rows, and every
flow action that reads a threshold or a point map had nothing to read — including
every action in 'REV | Scoring | Calculate & Flag'. Confirmed empty by a live
FetchXML query against REV-GrantApplications-DEV before this fix.
Only the `dataverse.settingRows` section is populated. DEV has no group-team
bindings, no bulk-delete jobs and no column-security-profile membership scripted in
Phase 1 (see the invariant above) — those stay test/prd-only. The row VALUES here
are copied from test-settings.json, not re-derived: DEV and TST/ACC should score
applications identically while SDD OQ-001/002/003 remain open for the board, so a
developer testing the scoring flow in DEV sees the same behaviour QA sees in
TST/ACC. If the board settles a threshold, update BOTH files (search the repo for
the key name) — this file is not read from test-settings.json at run time.
Identifiers only — never a secret, token or connection string (C-TECH-001). The
provisioning app id and certificate thumbprint stay in the environment variables
named under 'auth' (CI secrets / Key Vault), matching every other settings file.

tenantId is the real tenant id (matches dev-schema-settings.json), not an unresolved placeholder token: seed-settings.ps1 fails fast on any remaining {..} token (C-TECH-031/047), and there is exactly one tenant this script could ever run against for DEV.

settingRows.description: Maps a wellbeing answer's option VALUE to circumstance points (FR-013). Position 1 scores 5, position 5 scores 1. Key "6" ('Not sure') = 0, CHANGED FROM 0.5 on 2026-08-20 and confirmed with Emily (process owner). This supersedes the D-014 derivation from the hand-scored export; the map now holds no fractional value, so the half-point rounding can never fire. Full record: provisioning/deploymentSettings/settings-rows.notes.md#LikertPointMap.

Inverts the life-satisfaction answer rev_feelingscaleanswer, a whole number 0 to 10, so that a lower reported satisfaction scores more points (FR-012). This is 10 minus the raw answer, expressed as a lookup map so the direction of the scale is configuration rather than arithmetic inside the flow. REPLACED IN REVISION 0.3: it was a five-entry map over a five-option picklist. The Automation Solution Design v0.5 specifies exactly this for Automation #2 Q1 — "inverted (0/10 feeling = 10 points)".
Circumstance score at or below which the application status becomes Auto-reject. PROVISIONAL VALUE — same figure already accepted for TST/ACC (test-settings.json) — the board's figure is SDD OQ-001.
Lower bound (inclusive) of the Borderline review band. PROVISIONAL VALUE — same figure already accepted for TST/ACC (test-settings.json) — SDD OQ-002.
Upper bound (inclusive) of the Borderline review band; a score above it becomes Auto-pass. PROVISIONAL VALUE — same figure already accepted for TST/ACC (test-settings.json) — SDD OQ-002.
Annual household income ceiling in GBP. PROVISIONAL VALUE — same figure already accepted for TST/ACC (test-settings.json) — SDD OQ-003.

Maps the age-band labels the live form actually sends to rev_agerange (2=18-24 .. 8=75+, 9=Not known). Option 1 (Under 18) has no label (form gates on 18+). Full derivation kept in provisioning/deploymentSettings/settings-rows.notes.md#AgeRangeLabelMap (D-021).

Maps the uppercased alphabetic prefix of a UK outward code to a rev_locationarea option value (1=North East .. 12=Northern Ireland). Longest prefix wins, so match SW before S. Fixed reference data. Option 13 (Not known) is the fallback for an unrecognised or absent postcode and is therefore not in the map.

Maximum attainable circumstance score, for rendering 'n out of N': 10 wellbeing answers x 5 (50) plus the inverted life-satisfaction answer up to 10 = 60 (FR-011). Confirmed 60, not 55 — life-satisfaction is the 0-10 scale its source describes; matches the raw export header and Automation Solution Design v0.5. Unblocks KnockoutThreshold and the Borderline band (SDD OQ-001/002). Full derivation kept in provisioning/deploymentSettings/settings-rows.notes.md#MaxCircumstanceScore (D-021).

EF-29 (2026-09-17): re-seeded to Emily's four confirmed bands (Under 15,000 / 15,000-24,999 / 25,000-34,999 / Over 35,000), replacing the placeholder five-band, 10,000-boundary map and its 'Prefer not to say' sentinel. Maps each rev_incomeband option to the top of that band, compared against IncomeCeiling (FR-015). NFR-019: if the form's income bands change, this row changes, not the scoring flow. Option 4 (Over 35,000) is unbounded with a sentinel above any realistic ceiling. Full derivation kept in provisioning/deploymentSettings/settings-rows.notes.md#IncomeBandUpperBoundMap (D-021).

Minimum population for money-average measures on trustee landing screen; below this value is withheld, only count shown (TAD §6.3.5, OQ-043). Disclosure control, not tunable: reviewer decision 2026-08-28. Absent row withholds all four money measures (fail-safe but not approved behaviour); unseeded divergence between environments. See settings-rows.notes.md#RoundStatisticsMoneyMeasureMinimumPopulation.

Days an acceptance envelope may sit unsigned before REV | Acceptance | Reminders & Escalation notifies the process owner (FR-044, TAD 5.9). Added 2026-09-06 for wbs:3.3, DEV only per EX-006/EX-007. MIRRORED into test-settings.json/prd-settings.json on 2026-09-08 per reviewer confirmation that all three environments' rev_setting rows must agree at 18 — EX-006/EX-007 still scope the wbs:3.2/3.3/3.4 DocuSign FLOWS themselves to DEV only pending Revitalise's own DocuSign licence; this row is configuration data, not a flow promotion.

IMP-0618 RESOLVED 2026-09-06: reviewer decision - the seeded table drives the reminder cadence dynamically, discarding the DocuSign template's own static 2/5-day configuration entirely. [first, second] reminder day (FR-043, TAD 5.9). Read by REV | Acceptance | Create Envelope (wbs:3.2), which calls the DocuSign connector's AddReminders action once per envelope right after creation - not read by wbs:3.3, which remains escalation-only. See settings-rows.notes.md#ReminderDays for the delay/frequency shape mismatch this produces.

Freshness window (seconds) for the trustee landing screen's Refresh figures control (TAD §5.3.1, OQ-042). Reviewer decision (Emily) 2026-08-30, urgent fix for IMP-0511: unseeded left staleAfterSeconds null in every response document, so isCurrent()'s NaN comparison never returns true and no computed result was ever shown, including one this cycle's own poll just watched complete. 300 sits inside the two OQ-042 boundaries (above the ~12s poll bound, below a board-meeting length). Tunable, not a disclosure control like RoundStatisticsMoneyMeasureMinimumPopulation. See settings-rows.notes.md#RoundStatisticsStaleAfterSeconds.

settingRows.displayName: Round statistics: history tracking start date
settingRows.description: FR-080/FR-082, TAD ADR-049 §5.1.3, OQ-050 answer, reviewer decision 2026-09-19. The earliest month the all-history month-by-month application count covers. Unseeded is a valid, fail-safe state: months is emitted empty and trackingStartDate null, never an error (§5.1.3 point 1). A wrong value silently shifts every month boundary the feature will ever show — not a value to set experimentally. See settings-rows.notes.md#RoundStatisticsHistoryStartDate.

settingRows.displayName: Round statistics: applications received before tracking start
settingRows.description: FR-080/FR-082, TAD ADR-049 §5.1.3, OQ-050 answer, reviewer decision 2026-09-19. Applications received before RoundStatisticsHistoryStartDate, so the screen never silently understates the charity's total history. 0 is a genuine seeded value here, not an unseeded sentinel — Whole Number legitimately seeds to zero. Unseeded (while the start date IS seeded) sets understatedTotal true (§5.1.3 point 2). See settings-rows.notes.md#RoundStatisticsHistoryPriorApplicationCount.

FR-081, TAD ADR-050 §5.1.3 part 3, OQ-049 answer, reviewer decision 2026-09-19 (plan Addendum). A month is flagged anomalous when its count deviates from its own trailing six-month mean by more than this percentage. Unseeded, or fewer than six trailing months of history exist yet, sets anomaly null on that month (fail-safe, §5.1.3 point 4) — never a guessed flag, never a computation error. Lower-stakes than the two history settings above: a wrong value here mistunes which months get flagged, a sensitivity question correctable at any time with no history implication. See settings-rows.notes.md#RoundStatisticsMonthlyAnomalyThresholdPercent.

wbs:4.6 (CO-004), TAD postcode-lookup-architecture.md S13 (OQ-200), reviewer decision 2026-09-23 (Anna Southern), CO-004 TAD Revision 2. Same value as test-settings.json/prd-settings.json (DEV should score identically to TST/ACC/PRD — see this file's own top-level comment). An outward code is flagged Multi-Authority when a second local authority holds AT LEAST this percentage of its live unit postcodes; otherwise it resolves to the modal authority.
